summary: BTQ Technologies Corp. filed a Form 6-K with its interim financial statements and MD&A for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, containing unaudited financial results, certifications, and a going-concern note. No special-situation transaction is announced; the company reports significant losses and increased expenses but no M&A, tender, or restructuring event. The filing is purely informational and does not trigger any special-situations classification.
